name: ICM-20649 wide-range 6-DoF IMU
description: TDK InvenSense wide-range 6-axis motion sensor for high-impact use: 3-axis accelerometer (±4/8/16/30 g, 8192 LSB/g at ±4 g), 3-axis gyroscope (±500/1000/2000/4000 °/s, 65.5 LSB/(°/s) at ±500 °/s) and temperature sensor (333.87 LSB/°C, 0 LSB at 21 °C), I2C or SPI. Sold as: Adafruit ICM-20649 Wide-Range ±30g ±4000dps 6-DoF IMU breakout (#4464, STEMMA QT) with a 3.3 V regulator and SCL/SDA level shifting, 3–5 V supply, two 6-pin headers (VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, INT1 and AD0, FS, SCE, SDE, CS, INT2), I2C address 0x68 (0x69 with AD0 high).
eli5: Measures hard knocks and very fast spins, like a golf swing or a bat hitting a ball.

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Supply, 3–5 V, into the on-board AP2112K 3.3 V regulator; use the same voltage as your board's logic

pins.name: 3Vo
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board regulator (up to 100 mA); not a supply input, leave unconnected

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (SPI SCK); BSS138 level-shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up to VIN on the board

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (SPI SDI); BSS138 level-shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up to VIN on the board

pins.name: INT1
pins.description: Interrupt 1 output, straight from the chip at 3.3 V logic (not level-shifted), optional

pins.name: AD0
pins.description: Address select (SPI SDO), 3.3 V logic: 10 kΩ pull-down on the board = 0x68; pull to 3.3 V (or bridge the back jumper) for 0x69

pins.name: FS
pins.description: FSYNC input, tied to GND by a back jumper; 3.3 V logic only, leave unconnected

pins.name: SCE
pins.description: Auxiliary I2C clock (AUX_CL) for external sensors, 3.3 V logic only; leave unconnected

pins.name: SDE
pins.description: Auxiliary I2C data (AUX_DA) for external sensors, 3.3 V logic only; leave unconnected

pins.name: CS
pins.description: SPI chip select (diode-isolated, pulled high on the board for I2C); leave unconnected (low selects SPI)

pins.name: INT2
pins.description: Interrupt 2 output, straight from the chip at 3.3 V logic, optional

buildNotes: The board has two 6-pin headers on opposite edges, so wire it with jumper leads. Only VIN, GND, SCL and SDA are needed for I2C.

WHO_AM_I (bank 0, 0x00) reads 0xE1. Registers are split into four banks chosen by REG_BANK_SEL (0x7F, bank number in bits 5:4); the sensor data is in bank 0, GYRO_CONFIG_1 (0x01) and ACCEL_CONFIG (0x14) in bank 2.
The chip powers up asleep (PWR_MGMT_1 = 0x41): write PWR_MGMT_1 (0x06) = 0x01 to wake it with the auto clock, then wait about 35 ms for the gyroscope.

Read 0x2D..0x3A in one 14-byte burst: seven big-endian signed words, accel X/Y/Z, gyro X/Y/Z, then temperature. At the reset ranges (±4 g, ±500 °/s): 8192 LSB/g, 65.5 LSB/(°/s); temperature = raw / 333.87 + 21 °C.
SCL and SDA are level-shifted and pulled up to VIN, but INT1, INT2, AD0, FS, SCE and SDE connect straight to the chip at 3.3 V: never drive them from 5 V logic.
Default address is 0x68 (AD0 pulled down on the board); pull AD0 to 3.3 V or bridge the back jumper for 0x69.

driver.code:
# ICM-20649 wide-range 6-axis IMU (TDK InvenSense DS-000192 rev 1.0), MicroPython driver.
# Accelerometer (+-4/8/16/30 g), gyroscope (+-500/1000/2000/4000 dps) and temperature,
# read over I2C from user bank 0; full-scale settings live in user bank 2.
import time

_REG_BANK_SEL = 0x7F   # all banks: USER_BANK[1:0] in bits 5:4
# User bank 0
_WHO_AM_I = 0x00       # reads 0xE1
_PWR_MGMT_1 = 0x06     # reset value 0x41 (asleep, CLKSEL=1)
_PWR_MGMT_2 = 0x07
_ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x2D   # 0x2D..0x3A: accel X/Y/Z, gyro X/Y/Z, temperature (big-endian words)
# User bank 2
_GYRO_CONFIG_1 = 0x01
_ACCEL_CONFIG = 0x14

_ACCEL_LSB_PER_G = (8192, 4096, 2048, 1024)        # ACCEL_FS_SEL 0..3 = +-4/8/16/30 g
_GYRO_LSB_PER_DPS = (65.5, 32.8, 16.4, 8.2)        # GYRO_FS_SEL 0..3 = +-500/1000/2000/4000 dps
_TEMP_SENSITIVITY = 333.87                         # LSB/degC; room-temperature offset 0 LSB at 21 degC


def _s16(hi, lo):
    v = (hi << 8) | lo
    return v - 65536 if v & 0x8000 else v


class ICM20649:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x68, accel_fs=0, gyro_fs=0):
        """addr 0x68 with AD0 low (Adafruit default), 0x69 with AD0 high.
        accel_fs 0..3 = +-4/8/16/30 g, gyro_fs 0..3 = +-500/1000/2000/4000 dps."""
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        self._bank(0)
        who = self._r8(_WHO_AM_I)
        if who != 0xE1:
            raise OSError('ICM-20649 not found (WHO_AM_I=0x%02X): check wiring and address' % who)
        self._w8(_PWR_MGMT_1, 0x80)   # DEVICE_RESET (auto-clears); registers back to defaults
        time.sleep_ms(100)            # register access start-up time up to 100 ms
        self._bank(0)
        self._w8(_PWR_MGMT_1, 0x01)   # SLEEP=0, LP_EN=0, CLKSEL=1 (PLL when ready)
        time.sleep_ms(40)             # gyro start-up from sleep 35 ms
        self._w8(_PWR_MGMT_2, 0x00)   # accelerometer and gyroscope axes all on
        self._bank(2)
        self._w8(_GYRO_CONFIG_1, ((gyro_fs & 3) << 1) | 0x01)   # GYRO_FS_SEL, DLPF on
        self._w8(_ACCEL_CONFIG, ((accel_fs & 3) << 1) | 0x01)   # ACCEL_FS_SEL, DLPF on
        self._bank(0)
        self._a_lsb = _ACCEL_LSB_PER_G[accel_fs & 3]
        self._g_lsb = _GYRO_LSB_PER_DPS[gyro_fs & 3]
        time.sleep_ms(20)

    def _bank(self, n):
        self._w8(_REG_BANK_SEL, (n & 3) << 4)

    def _w8(self, reg, v):
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, reg, bytes([v]))

    def _r8(self, reg):
        return self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, reg, 1)[0]

    def read(self):
        """Return ((ax, ay, az) in g, (gx, gy, gz) in deg/s, temperature in degC)."""
        d = self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, _ACCEL_XOUT_H, 14)
        w = [_s16(d[i], d[i + 1]) for i in range(0, 14, 2)]
        a = (w[0] / self._a_lsb, w[1] / self._a_lsb, w[2] / self._a_lsb)
        g = (w[3] / self._g_lsb, w[4] / self._g_lsb, w[5] / self._g_lsb)
        t = w[6] / _TEMP_SENSITIVITY + 21   # TEMP_degC = (TEMP_OUT - 0) / 333.87 + 21
        return a, g, t

    def acceleration(self):
        return self.read()[0]

    def gyro(self):
        return self.read()[1]

    def temperature(self):
        return self.read()[2]

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from icm20649 import ICM20649

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
imu = ICM20649(i2c)
while True:
    (ax, ay, az), (gx, gy, gz), t = imu.read()
    print('A=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f g G=%.1f,%.1f,%.1f dps T=%.1fC' % (ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz, t))
    time.sleep(1)
